title: Music City Getaway
description:
Welcome to Music City Getaway!

Beautiful and cozy single level home with 3 Beds and 2 Baths.  Located in a quiet neighborhood less than two miles from the interstate making access to Nashville and surrounding attractions easy to get to. Perfect space to gather and create lasting memories! Complete with a fenced in backyard, ping pong table, washer/dryer & fully stocked kitchen! 

We aim to provide the highest level of hospitality and cleanliness. Please, make yourself at home, relax and enjoy!

The space
Be sure to ❤️ our listing to your Airbnb Wish List so you can find us easily next time! 

⭐️ 20 mins to downtown Nashville

BEDROOMS
⭐️Bedroom #1 King Size Bed, en-suite bathroom, 50” Roku HD TV
⭐️Bedroom #2 Queen Size Bed
⭐️Bedroom #3 King Size Bed

Guest access
Entire Property is included in this listing. 

Check-in via electronic keypad lock located on the front door. Access code will be sent one hour prior to arrival.

Other things to note
Please treat our house with respect. If any problems arise, we will do our best to take action ASAP. We hope you have a great stay!
